description.en: $tschl_uplim is the upper income limit (maximum contribution base) applied to the earnings-related component of the health insurance (ZVW) contribution; rather than holding its own amount it is currently defined as a formula equal to $EI_Maxpremwag, the maximum premium-wage constant. It is used in tschl_nl/SchedCalc as band_uplim for 'Earnings-related health insurance contribution - part 1' and in tschl_nl/BenCalc as comp_perTU for 'part 2', capping the income on which the employee and self-employed/pension ZVW rates ($tschl_rate_emp, $tschl_rate_se) are charged. Per the Country Report, from 2012 this ceiling was harmonized with (raised to) the maximum base used for the employee unemployment/disability insurance contributions — explaining the reference to $EI_Maxpremwag — and this combined maximum base reached €75,860 per year by 2025.
